            return 0
        end

    local v141 = v140:Dot(v140)
    v133 = if v141 > 1E-09 then math.clamp((u6 - u8):Dot(v140) / v141, 0, 1) else 0

    local v143 = v142:Dot(v142)
    local v144 = if v143 > 1E-09 then math.clamp((u7 - u8):Dot(v142) / v143, 0, 1) else 0
    local v145 = u7 - u6

function t_7._via(t10: table, vec12: Vector3) -- line: 566

        v156 = v149
        v157 = v155 * (v154 + v152)

        v157 = v155 * (v154 + v152)
    end

function t_7._colliderHit(t19: table, vec27: Vector3, vec28: Vector3, n41: number) -- line: 1058
    local Collider_1 = t19.collider
    local Position_2, vec3_16, vec3_17, vec3_18

    if Collider_1 then
        if t19.model:GetAttribute("BodyState") ~= "Animated" then
            return nil, nil
        end

        Position_2 = Collider_1.Position
        local v343 = Collider_1.Size.X / 2
        local v344 = Collider_1.Size.Y / 2 + n41
        local v345 = vec27 - Position_2
        vec3_16 = Vector3.new(v345.X, 0, v345.Z)
        local v346 = vec28 - vec27
        vec3_17 = Vector3.new(v346.X, 0, v346.Z)
        local v347 = vec3_17:Dot(vec3_17)
        local v348 = 2 * vec3_16:Dot(vec3_17)
        local v350 = vec3_16:Dot(vec3_16) - v344 * v344
        local v351

        if v350 <= 0 then
            v351 = 0
        else
            if v347 < 1E-09 then
                return nil, nil
            end

            local v352 = v348 * v348 - 4 * v347 * v350

            if v352 < 0 then
                return nil, nil
            end

            v351 = (-v348 - math.sqrt(v352)) / (2 * v347)

            if v351 < 0 or v351 > 1 then
                return nil, nil
            end
        end

        local v354 = vec27:Lerp(vec28, v351)

        if math.abs(v354.Y - Position_2.Y) > v343 + n41 * 0.5 then
            return nil, nil
        end

        local v356 = v354 - Position_2
        vec3_18 = Vector3.new(v356.X, 0, v356.Z)
        local v357 = v351

        if vec3_18.Magnitude > 0.0001 then
            return v357, vec3_18.Unit
        end

        local v358 = vec28 - vec27

        return v357, -Vector3.new(v358.X, 0, v358.Z).Unit
    else
        return nil, nil
    end
end

    local _, v363 = t20:_seenLate()

local function catchChance(n49: number) -- line: 1337
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] Config_m (copy)

    if n49 <= Config_m.CatchSure then
        return 1
    end

    if n49 <= Config_m.CatchEasy then
        return (Config_m.CatchChance - 1) * ((n49 - Config_m.CatchSure) / (Config_m.CatchEasy - Config_m.CatchSure)) + 1
    end

    return Config_m.CatchChance * (1 - math.clamp(
        (n49 - Config_m.CatchEasy) / (Config_m.CatchSpeed - Config_m.CatchEasy),
        0,
        1
    ))
end

    local v450 = math.clamp(math.floor((n50 - Ts_5[1]) / BallSim_m.STEP) + 1, 1, v449 - 1)

    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] MannequinCharacters (copy)
    --  [2] CollectionService (copy)
    --  [3] Smother_m (copy)
    --  [4] PossessionService (copy)
    --  [5] World_m (copy)
    --  [6] t_1 (copy)
    --  [7] gapToPart (copy)
    --  [8] Config_m (copy)
    --  [9] t_2 (copy)

    local Model_3 = t33.model
    local v521 = MannequinCharacters.getAnimator(Model_3)
    local v522 = v521

    if v522 then
        v522 = v521:getBody()
    end

    local v523 = CollectionService:GetTagged("SoccerBall")[1]
    v521 = if v523 then if v523:IsA("BasePart") then v523 else nil else nil

    if not v521 or not v522 or v522.mode ~= "Slide" or v522.slideEnd ~= nil then
        Smother_m.set(Model_3, nil)

        return false
    end

    v522 = v521.Position
    v521 = t33.smotherLast or v522
    t33.smotherLast = v522
    Smother_m.set(Model_3, "reach", v522)
    local v524 = PossessionService.getPossessor()
    local Radius_2

    if v524 ~= Model_3 then
        if v524 and not t33:_rival(v524) then
            return false
        end

        Radius_2 = World_m.params().radius
        local v525 = false

        for index_21 = 0, 3 do
            local v526 = v521:Lerp(v522, index_21 / 3)

            for _, val_17 in t_1 do
                local v527 = Model_3:FindFirstChild(val_17)

                if v527 and v527:IsA("BasePart") then
                    if gapToPart(v527, v526) <= Radius_2 + Config_m.SmotherReach then
                        v525 = true
                    end
                end
            end

            for _, val_18 in t_2 do
                local v529 = Model_3:FindFirstChild(val_18)

                if v529 and v529:IsA("BasePart") then
                    if gapToPart(v529, v526) <= Radius_2 + 0.15 then
                        v525 = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if v525 then

                return false
            end

            t33:_caught(n59, v522)
            t33.act.down = true
            Smother_m.set(Model_3, "hold")

            return false
        end

        return false
    end
end

function t_7._airHold(arg16) -- line: 1772

    --  [1] World_m (copy)

            if v536:IsA("BasePart") then
                if not RightHand:IsA("BasePart") then
                    return arg16:_holdPoint()
                end

                Chest = Model_5:FindFirstChild("Chest")
                local v538 = v537 - (if Chest then if Chest:IsA("BasePart") then Chest.Position else arg16.root.Position else arg16.root.Position)

                return arg16:_outOfGoal(v537 + v536 * (World_m.params().radius * 0.75))

function t_7._outOfGoal(t37: table, vec41: Vector3) -- line: 1790
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] World_m (copy)

    local Goal_17 = t37.goal
    local Radius_3 = World_m.params().radius
    local v540 = World_m.get().groundY - Radius_3

    if math.abs(vec41.Z - Goal_17.z) >= Goal_17.halfWidth + Radius_3 or vec41.Y - v540 >= Goal_17.height + Radius_3 then
        return vec41
    end

    return (Vector3.new(
        Goal_17.lineX - Goal_17.side * math.max(
            (Goal_17.lineX - vec41.X) * Goal_17.side,
            Radius_3 + 0.5
        ),
        vec41.Y,
        vec41.Z
    ))
end

    --  [1] Config_m (copy)

            v545 = if v544 < 0 then -math.sign(v542) else math.sign(v542)

function t_7._send(t41: table, n64: number) -- line: 2001
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] AIGoalie_m (copy)
    --  [2] Config_m (copy)
    --  [3] World_m (copy)
    --  [4] Kick_m (copy)
    --  [5] Distribute_m (copy)

    local Act_1 = t41.act

        Act_1.rate = Config_m.MovePace

    end

    t41.mode = "punt"

        v595

    Act_1.from = v597
    Act_1.push = v599
    Act_1.drop = n64 + AIGoalie_m.PUNT_EXTEND
    Act_1.strike = Act_1.drop + v598
    Act_1.ball = v596
    Act_1.vel = Distribute_m.solve(v596, Pass.to, Pass.T, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))

            v596,
            Vector3.new(v596.X, 0, v596.Z) + t41.out * Config_m.ClearRange[1],
            Config_m.PuntTime[1],
            Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        )

function t_7._gather(t45: table, n70: number) -- line: 2071

    --  [4] PossessionService (copy)

    if not BallService.running() then
        return false
    end

    local v603 = BallService.current()
    local v604, v605 = BallService.sample(n70)
    local Root_9 = t45.root

    if t45:_ownBall(v603, n70) then
        if not t45:_sent(v603) and t45:_mayHandle(v604) then
            local v606 = v604 - Root_9.Position

                t45:_move(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Config_m.MoveSpeed, t45:_faceFor(v604))

            end
        end

    end

    local v607 = World_m.get()
    local Radius_4 = World_m.params().radius
    local v608 = v607.groundY - Radius_4
    local v609 = v604.Y - v608 <= Config_m.GatherHeight and true

function t.GetCameraMovementModeFromSettings(_) -- line: 221

    local v20, v21

    if UserInputService.PreferredInput == Enum.PreferredInput.Touch then

            Players.LocalPlayer.DevComputerCameraMode

    end

function t.ActivateOcclusionModule(arg4, arg5) -- line: 246
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] Poppercam_m (copy)
    --  [2] Invisicam_m (copy)
    --  [3] t_4 (copy)
    --  [4] Players (copy)

    local v22

    if arg5 == Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Zoom then
        v22 = Poppercam_m
    elseif arg5 == Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Invisicam then
        v22 = Invisicam_m
    else
        warn("CameraScript ActivateOcclusionModule called with unsupported mode")

        return
    end

    arg4.occlusionMode = arg5

    if arg4.activeOcclusionModule and arg4.activeOcclusionModule:GetOcclusionMode() == arg5 then
        if not arg4.activeOcclusionModule:GetEnabled() then
            arg4.activeOcclusionModule:Enable(true)
        end

        return
    end

    local ActiveOcclusionModule = arg4.activeOcclusionModule
    arg4.activeOcclusionModule = t_4[v22]

    if not arg4.activeOcclusionModule then
        arg4.activeOcclusionModule = v22.new()

        if arg4.activeOcclusionModule then
            t_4[v22] = arg4.activeOcclusionModule
        end
    end

    if arg4.activeOcclusionModule then
        if arg4.activeOcclusionModule:GetOcclusionMode() ~= arg5 then
            warn(
                "CameraScript ActivateOcclusionModule mismatch: ",
                arg4.activeOcclusionModule:GetOcclusionMode(),
                "~=",
                arg5
            )
        end

        if ActiveOcclusionModule then
            if ActiveOcclusionModule ~= arg4.activeOcclusionModule then
                ActiveOcclusionModule:Enable(false)
            else
                warn(
                    "CameraScript ActivateOcclusionModule failure to detect already running correct module"
                )
            end
        end

        if arg5 == Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Invisicam then
            if Players.LocalPlayer.Character then
                arg4.activeOcclusionModule:CharacterAdded(
                    Players.LocalPlayer.Character,
                    Players.LocalPlayer
                )
            end
        else
            for _, val_3 in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if val_3 and val_3.Character then
                    arg4.activeOcclusionModule:CharacterAdded(val_3.Character, val_3)
                end
            end

            arg4.activeOcclusionModule:OnCameraSubjectChanged(
                game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject
            )
        end

        arg4.activeOcclusionModule:Enable(true)
    end
end

function t.ShouldUseVehicleCamera(arg6) -- line: 325
    local v24 = workspace.CurrentCamera

function t.ActivateCameraController(arg7) -- line: 341

    local CameraType: userdata = workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType

    local v29 = nil

    if CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then

    end

        v28 = arg7:GetCameraMovementModeFromSettings()

    elseif CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Follow then

    elseif CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Orbital then
        v28 = Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Orbital

        v29 = LegacyCamera_m
    else

    end

            v29 = VRCamera_m
        elseif v28 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Classic or (v28 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Follow or (v28 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Default or v28 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.CameraToggle)) then
            v29 = ClassicCamera_m
        elseif v28 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Orbital then
            v29 = OrbitalCamera_m
        else
            warn("ActivateCameraController did not select a module.")

            return
        end
    end

    if arg7:ShouldUseVehicleCamera() then
        v29 = if not VRService.VREnabled then VehicleCamera_m else VRVehicleCamera_m

    end

            if v30.HandleSubjectDistance then
                v30:HandleSubjectDistance(arg7.activeCameraController)
            end

            arg7.activeCameraController:Enable(false)
            arg7.activeCameraController = v30
            arg7.activeCameraController:Enable(true)
        elseif not arg7.activeCameraController:GetEnabled() then
            arg7.activeCameraController:Enable(true)
        end

    end

        arg7.activeCameraController:SetCameraType(CameraType)

function t.calculateRawMoveVector(t2: table, u3: userdata, vec1: Vector3) -- line: 619
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] Workspace (copy)
    --  [2] VRService (copy)
    --  [3] CameraRotationAction (copy)

    local v49 = Workspace.CurrentCamera

    if not v49 then
        return vec1
    end

    local v50 = v49.CFrame

    if VRService.VREnabled and u3.RootPart then
        local v51 = t2:GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame()

        if (v49.Focus.Position - v50.Position).Magnitude < 3 then
            v50 *= v51
        else
            v50 = v49.CFrame * (v51.Rotation + v51.Position * v49.HeadScale)
        end
    end

    if u3:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
        if VRService.VREnabled then
            vec1 = Vector3.new(vec1.X, 0, vec1.Z)

            if vec1.Magnitude < 0.01 then
                return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            end

            v49 = if CameraRotationAction and CameraRotationAction.Enabled then -CameraRotationAction:GetState().Y / 2.31 else 0
            local v52 = math.atan2(-vec1.X, -vec1.Z)
            local _, v54, _ = v50:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()

            return CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(v49, v52 + v54, 0).LookVector
        else
            return v50:VectorToWorldSpace(vec1)
        end
    else
        local _, _, _, v59, v60, v61, _, _, v64, _, _, v67 = v50:GetComponents()
        local v68, v69

        if v64 < 1 and v64 > -1 then
            v68 = v67
            v69 = v61
        else
            v68 = v59
            v69 = -v60 * math.sign(v64)
        end

        local v71 = math.sqrt(v68 * v68 + v69 * v69)

        return (Vector3.new(
            (v68 * vec1.X + v69 * vec1.Z) / v71,
            0,
            (v68 * vec1.Z - v69 * vec1.X) / v71
        ))
    end
end

    Group = "DefaultUtil",
    Args = {},
    ClientRun = nil
}
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

function t.ClientRun() -- line: 11
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] LocalPlayer (copy)
    --  [2] Players (copy)

    local Target = LocalPlayer:GetMouse().Target

    if not Target then
        return ""
    end

    local playerFromCharacter = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(
        Target:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    )

    if playerFromCharacter then
        return `{playerFromCharacter.DisplayName} @({playerFromCharacter.Name})`
    end

    return ""
end

    Group = "DefaultUtil",
    Args = {
        { Type = "string", Name = "Script", Description = "The script to parse.", Default = "" }

                if v1 then

                end
            end
        end

        return ""
    end

return {
    Name = "thru",
    Aliases = { "t", "through" },
    Description = "Teleports you through whatever your mouse is hovering over, placing you equidistantly from the wall.",
    Group = "DefaultDebug",
    Args = {
        {
            Type = "number",
            Name = "Extra distance",
            Description = "Go through the wall an additional X studs.",
            Default = 0
        }
    },
    Guards = {
        require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").CmdrClient.Shared.BuiltInGuards.HasCharacter)()
    },
    ClientRun = function(arg1: any, n1: number) --[[ ClientRun ]] -- line: 23
        local mouse = arg1.Executor:GetMouse()
        local Character = arg1.Executor.Character
        local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
        raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Character }
        raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true
        raycastParams.RespectCanCollide = true
        local v2 = workspace:Raycast(
            mouse.UnitRay.Origin,
            mouse.UnitRay.Direction * 1000,
            raycastParams
        )

        if v2 then
            local Position = HumanoidRootPart.Position
            local v3 = v2.Position - Position
            Character:MoveTo(
                v3 * 2 + (if v3.Magnitude > 0 then v3.Unit else Vector3.new()) * n1 + Position
            )

            return "Thru the wall!"
        end

        Character:MoveTo(mouse.Hit.Position)

        return "Blinked (No wall found)!"
    end

function t_7.sample(arg7: any, n15: number) -- line: 445

local function distance(u1: Color3, u2: Color3) -- line: 89
    local v3 = u1.R * 255
    local v4 = u2.R * 255
    local v5 = (v3 + v4) / 2
    local v6 = v3 - v4
    local v7 = u1.G * 255 - u2.G * 255
    local v8 = u1.B * 255 - u2.B * 255

    return (math.sqrt((2 + v5 / 256) * v6 * v6 + 4 * v7 * v7 + (2 + (255 - v5) / 256) * v8 * v8))
end

function t.fromStick(u4: Vector2) -- line: 730

    --  [1] t (copy)

function t.mouth(n1: number) -- line: 911
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] Practice_m (copy)

    local v11, v12 = Practice_m.pitch()

    if not v11 or not v12 then
        return nil
    end

    local v13 = v11:PointToWorldSpace((Vector3.new(v12.X / 2, 0, 0)))
    local v14 = v11:PointToWorldSpace((Vector3.new(-v12.X / 2, 0, 0)))

    if (v13.X - v11.Position.X) * n1 > 0 then
        return v13
    end

    return v14
end

function t.encode(t5: table) -- line: 951

function t.codeOk(s1: string) -- line: 127
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] t (copy)

        return false
    end

local function segment(t5: table, n4: number) -- line: 440

    --  [1] Workspace (copy)

end

function t.updateShape(arg1) -- line: 267

    end

function t.roll(n2: number, n3: number, t1: table) -- line: 226
    if n2 <= 0 or n3 <= 0 then
        return 0, (math.max(n2, 0))
    end

    local Roll = t1.roll
    local Drag = t1.drag

    if Drag < 1E-09 then
        if Roll < 1E-09 then
            return n2 * n3, n2
        end

        local v48 = math.min(n3, n2 / Roll)

        return n2 * v48 - Roll * 0.5 * v48 * v48, (math.max(n2 - Roll * n3, 0))
    else
        if Roll < 1E-09 then
            local v50 = Drag * n2 * n3 + 1

            return math.log(v50) / Drag, n2 / v50
        end

        local v51 = math.sqrt(Roll / Drag)
        local v52 = math.sqrt(Roll * Drag)
        local v53 = math.atan(n2 / v51)
        local v54 = v53 - v52 * n3

        if v54 <= 0 then
            return -math.log((math.cos(v53))) / Drag, 0
        end

    end
end

function t.stopTime(n4: number, t2: table) -- line: 255
    if n4 <= 0 then
        return 0
    end

function t.checkTouch(
    arg2: any,
    arg3: any,
    n7: number,
    vec4: Vector3,
    n8: number,
    arg4: any,
    n9: number?,
    n10: number?
) -- line: 728
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] BallPath_m (copy)
    --  [2] t (copy)

    if arg2 then
        if arg3.pid ~= arg2.pid then
            return false, "possession"
        end

        if arg3.seq <= arg2.seq then
            return false, "order"
        end

        if arg3.t0 < arg2.t0 - 0.001 then
            return false, "time"
        end

        if BallPath_m.flat(BallPath_m.sample(arg2, arg3.t0, arg4) - arg3.p0).Magnitude > 1 then
            return false, "continuity"
        end
    end

    if arg3.t0 > n7 + 0.25 or arg3.t0 < n7 - t.Server.LateMax then
        return false, "clock"
    end

    if arg3.t1 - arg3.t0 > 1 then
        return false, "carry"
    end

    if (if arg3.kind == "Glue" then t.Touch.MaxLaunch * t.Glue.Overspeed + 1 else t.Touch.MaxLaunch + 1) < arg3.v0.Magnitude or arg3.v1.Magnitude > t.Touch.MaxLaunch + 1 then
        return false, "speed"
    end

    local Magnitude_2 = BallPath_m.flat(arg3.p1 - arg3.p0).Magnitude

    if Magnitude_2 > 6 and (arg3.kind ~= "Glue" or not (Magnitude_2 <= (t.Touch.MaxLaunch + 1) * (arg3.t1 - arg3.t0) + 1)) then
        return false, "carry"
    end

    local Server = t.Server
    local v13 = math.max(n7 - arg3.t0, 0) + math.max(
        Server.SeeLate,
        (math.min(n9 or 0, Server.LateMax))
    )
    local v15 = math.max(n8, Server.MinSpeed, (math.min(n10 or 0, Server.MaxPace))) * v13 + 5
    local Magnitude_1 = BallPath_m.flat(arg3.p0 - vec4).Magnitude

    if Magnitude_1 > v15 then
        return false, string.format(
            "reach (%.1f away, reach %.1f, seen %.2f s late)",
            Magnitude_1,
            v15,
            v13
        )
    end

    return true, nil
end

local function facingAt(t7: table, n12: number, vec11: Vector3?) -- line: 336

function t_5._crosses(
    _: any,
    t35: table,
    arg36: any,
    t36: table,
    vec32: Vector3,
    vec33: Vector3,
    s11: string,
    vec34: Vector3
) -- line: 980
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] Motion_m (copy)
    --  [2] BALLRADIUS (copy)
    --  [3] t_1 (copy)

    local v240 = Motion_m.at(arg36, t36.touch - t35.now)
    local v241 = vec33:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
    local v242 = vec32 - v240
    local v243 = Vector3.new(v242.X, 0, v242.Z):Dot(v241)

    if s11 ~= "Sole" then
        v243 -= Vector3.new(vec34.X, 0, vec34.Z):Dot(v241) * (0.24 + BALLRADIUS)
    end

    return -t_1[t36.leg] * v243
end

function t_5._spin(arg70: any, t56: table, b10: boolean, vec56: Vector3) -- line: 1685
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] Touch (copy)

    local Spin = Touch.Spin

    if not Spin then
        return 0
    end

    local Now_11 = t56.now
    local SpinDir = arg70.spinDir
    local SpinAt = arg70.spinAt
    arg70.spinDir = if not b10 then nil else vec56
    arg70.spinAt = Now_11

    if not b10 or not SpinDir or not SpinAt or Now_11 <= SpinAt or Now_11 - SpinAt > 0.1 then
        arg70.spinRate = 0

        return 0
    end

    local Y_2 = SpinDir:Cross(vec56).Y
    local v531 = math.atan2(Y_2, (SpinDir:Dot(vec56)))

    if math.abs(v531) > Spin.Jump then
        arg70.spinRate = 0

        return 0
    end

    local v533 = Now_11 - SpinAt
    local v534 = arg70.spinRate or 0
    v534 += (v531 / v533 - v534) * math.clamp(v533 / Spin.Smooth, 0, 1)
    arg70.spinRate = v534

    if math.abs(v534) >= Spin.Min then
        return v534
    end

    return 0
end

function t_5.update(arg73: any, t60: table) -- line: 2314
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] wallInput (copy)
    --  [2] BallPath_m (copy)
    --  [3] Rules_m (copy)
    --  [4] pastLines (copy)

    local Walls_2: any = t60.P.walls
    local v776 = if Walls_2 and t60.input.Magnitude > 0.1 then wallInput(
        Walls_2,
        t60.pos,
        t60.vel,

    ) else nil
    local v777 = if not Rules_m.Move.BodyFirst then arg73._update else arg73._updateFree
    local v778

        v778 = v777(arg73, t60)
    else

        if not arg73.assist then

                    Magnitude_62,
                    1

            arg73.face = v776 / Magnitude_62

    end

local _ = function(vec2: Vector3, vec3: Vector3) --[[ unit ]] -- line: 78

        return vec2.Unit
    end

end

local _ = function(vec4: Vector3) --[[ yawOf ]] -- line: 82

local _ = function(vec5: Vector3, vec6: Vector3) --[[ angle ]] -- line: 86

function t_2.knock(
    t14: table,
    vec6: Vector3,
    vec7: Vector3,
    vec8: Vector3?,
    _: number?,
    vec9: Vector3?,
    b4: boolean?
) -- line: 490
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] Tuning_m (copy)

    if t14.active then
        return
    end

        t14:_frontFall(
            t14.parts[t14.sk.pelvisName].AssemblyLinearVelocity + (vec8 or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) + vec6 * Tuning_m.FrontFall.KnockShare,
            vec9,

        )

        return
    end

    t14:fall()
    local t_17 = { knock = nil }
    local t_18 = { dv = vec6, point = vec7, carry = vec8 or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), spin = vec9 }

end

function t_2.kickFall(t15: table, vec10: Vector3, vec11: Vector3?, b5: boolean?) -- line: 522
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] Tuning_m (copy)

    if t15.active then
        return false
    end

    if b5 then
        return t15:_frontFall(vec10, vec11)
    end

    local KickFall = Tuning_m.KickFall
    local Sk_1 = t15.sk
    local Parts = t15.parts
    local v64 = Parts[Sk_1.pelvisName]

    if vec10.Magnitude > KickFall.MaxSpeed then
        vec10 = vec10.Unit * KickFall.MaxSpeed
    end

    local v65 = Sk_1:boneOf(Sk_1.pelvisName, v64.CFrame)
    local UpVector = v65.UpVector
    local UpVector_1 = Sk_1:boneOf("Chest", Parts.Chest.CFrame).UpVector
    local v66 = Vector3.new(UpVector_1.X, 0, UpVector_1.Z)

    if v66.Magnitude < 0.3 then
        local LookVector_1 = v65.LookVector
        v66 = -Vector3.new(LookVector_1.X, 0, LookVector_1.Z)
    end

    if v66.Magnitude < 0.001 then
        local LookVector_2 = t15.root.CFrame.LookVector
        v66 = -Vector3.new(LookVector_2.X, 0, LookVector_2.Z)
    end

    v66 = v66.Unit
    local Unit = (Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)):Cross(v66).Unit
    local v68 = math.acos((math.clamp(UpVector.Y, -1, 1)))
    local v69 = workspace.Gravity
    local v70 = t15:_com()
    local v71 = math.max(v70.Y - t15:_groundY(v70) - KickFall.LandCom, 0)
    local Y_2 = vec10.Y
    local v72 = math.max((Y_2 + math.sqrt(Y_2 * Y_2 + 2 * v69 * v71)) / v69, 0.15)
    local v73 = math.clamp((KickFall.LandTilt - v68) / v72, KickFall.Spin[1], KickFall.Spin[2])
    v69 = if vec11 then math.max(v73, (math.min(vec11:Dot(Unit), KickFall.MaxSpin))) else v73 * KickFall.LegSpin
    t15:_goPhysical()
    t15.mode = "KickFall"
    local t_19 = {
        v = vec10,
        w = Unit * v73,
        legW = Unit * v69,
        axis = Unit,
        back = v66,
        rate = v73,
        roll = math.min(v73 * v72, (math.max(KickFall.MaxTilt - v68, 0))),
        from = v64.CFrame.Rotation,
        launched = false,
        landed = nil
    }
    t15.fromKick = t_19
    t15.fallDir = v66
    local Assist = t15.assist
    Assist.orientation.CFrame = v64.CFrame.Rotation
    Assist.orientation.MaxTorque = 0
    Assist.orientation.Enabled = true
    t15.model:SetAttribute("BodyState", "Ragdoll")

    return true
end

function t_2._stepFall(t20: table, n12: number) -- line: 906
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] Tuning_m (copy)
    --  [2] t (copy)
    --  [3] mix (copy)
    --  [4] symmetric (copy)
    --  [5] t_10 (copy)
    --  [6] t_4 (copy)
    --  [7] Layers_m (copy)
    --  [8] t_5 (copy)

    local Fall_2 = Tuning_m.Fall
    local T_2 = t20.t
    local Anim_2 = t20.anim
    local Parts_4 = t20.parts
    local Pending = t20.pending

    if Pending then
        t20.pending = nil
        local Impulse = Pending.impulse
        local Knock = Pending.knock
        local v175

        if Knock then
            local Spread = Tuning_m.AirKnock.Spread
            local Spin = Knock.spin
            v175 = if Spin then t20:_com() else Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

            for _, val_22 in Parts_4 do
                if val_22 ~= t20.root then
                    local v176 = math.clamp(
                        1 - (val_22.Position - Knock.point).Magnitude / Spread,
                        0,
                        1
                    )
                    local v178 = if Spin then Spin:Cross(val_22.Position - v175) else Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    val_22:ApplyImpulse((Knock.carry + v178 + Knock.dv * v176) * val_22:GetMass())
                end
            end
        else
            local v181

            if Impulse and Pending.swept then
                v181 = Tuning_m.Slide

    if T_2 > Fall_2.MinDownTime then
        if not (t20.still > Fall_2.SettleTime) then

        else

        end
    elseif T_2 > Fall_2.MaxDownTime and not t20:_aloft() then

function t_2._beginGetUp(t21: table, b6: boolean?) -- line: 1014
    local v212 = t21.parts
    local v213 = v212[t21.sk.pelvisName]
    local v214 = v212.Chest.CFrame

    t21.t = 0

    t21.prone = v215
    local v216 = v212.Head.Position - v213.Position
    v215 = Vector3.new(v216.X, 0, v216.Z)

function t_2._com(arg8) -- line: 1057
    local v217 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    local v218 = 0

    for _, val_25 in arg8.parts do
        if val_25 ~= arg8.root then
            local Mass = val_25.Mass
            v217 += val_25.Position * Mass
            v218 += Mass
        end
    end

    return v217 / math.max(v218, 1E-06)
end

local function drivePlant(
    arg23: any,
    arg24: any,
    n45: number,
    arg25: any,
    arg26: any,

    n47: number
) -- line: 701
    -- upvalues:

local function panelAt(n8: number, vec6: Vector3) -- line: 530

    --  [1] NetGeometry_m (copy)

    local TOP_4 = NetGeometry_m.TOP

    local DEPTHBOTTOM = NetGeometry_m.DEPTH_BOTTOM

            v99,
            v98 - v99,

        local v105 = math.min(math.abs(vec6.Z), HALFWIDTH_4)

        v107,

local function seen(arg21) -- line: 678
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] t (copy)

    local DrawCentre = arg21.drawCentre

        return true
    end

    local v142 = DrawCentre - CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
    local Magnitude_8 = v142.Magnitude

        local v143 = math.tan(math.rad(CurrentCamera.FieldOfView) / 2)
        local v145 = v143 * ViewportSize.X / math.max(ViewportSize.Y, 1)

        if math.atan((math.sqrt(v145 * v145 + v143 * v143))) < math.acos(
            (math.clamp(CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(v142) / Magnitude_8, -1, 1))
        ) - math.asin(arg21.drawRadius / Magnitude_8) then

        end
    end

    local v150 = if not (Magnitude_8 > t.FAR) then if not ((arg21.drawSpeed or 0) < t.SLOW) then nil else t.SLOW_HZ else t.FAR_HZ

    if v150 and clock - arg21.drawnAt < 0.8 / v150 then

    end

    return true
end

local function fit(t4: table, u17: userdata) -- line: 627
    local Adornee: userdata = t4.gui.Adornee
    local Position

    if Adornee then
        if not Adornee:IsA("BasePart") then
            return
        end

        Position = Adornee.Position
        local v99 = 2 * (Position - u17.CFrame.Position).Magnitude * math.tan(
            math.rad(u17.FieldOfView) / 2
        )
        local v100 = math.clamp(t4.size.Y, 0.47 * v99, 0.67 * v99)

        if math.abs(v100 - t4.height) <= v100 * 0.005 then
            return
        end

        t4.height = v100
        t4.gui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(v100 * t4.size.X / t4.size.Y, v100)

        if t4.floorY then
            t4.gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(
                0,
                math.max(0, t4.floorY + 1 + v100 / 2 - Position.Y),
                0
            )
        end

        return
    else
        return
    end
end

local function onPlayZone(u18: userdata, vec1: Vector3) -- line: 646
    local QueueZone = u18:FindFirstChild("queueZone")

    if QueueZone then
        if not QueueZone:IsA("Model") then
            return false
        end

        local v103, v104 = QueueZone:GetBoundingBox()
        local v105 = v103:PointToObjectSpace(vec1)
        local v106 = false

        if math.abs(v105.X) <= v104.X / 2 then
            local v108 = math.abs(v105.Z)
            v106 = v108 <= v104.Z / 2 and true
        end

        return v106
    else
        return false
    end
end

            v24 = Instance.new("Model")
            v24.Name = "FeaturedHead"
            local v26 = Head:Clone()

            for _, child in v26:GetChildren() do
                if not child:IsA("Constraint") then

                    end
                else
                    child:Destroy()
                end
            end

            v26.CFrame = (Mannequin:GetPivot():Inverse() * Head.CFrame).Rotation
            v26.Anchored = true
            v26.Parent = v24
            Locker_m.dress(v24, { [s8] = s9 })
            Skin = bodyColors().Skin

            for _, descendant in v24:GetDescendants() do

                    descendant.CanCollide, descendant.CanQuery, descendant.CanTouch = false, false, false
                elseif descendant:IsA("WeldConstraint") then

        else

        end

    end

local function holdWorn(u11: userdata) -- line: 306
    for _, descendant_3 in u11:GetDescendants() do
        if descendant_3:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
            local Part0 = descendant_3.Part0
            local Part1 = descendant_3.Part1

            if Part0 and Part1 then
                local Weld = Instance.new("Weld")
                Weld.Name = descendant_3.Name
                Weld.Part0 = Part0
                Weld.Part1 = Part1
                Weld.C0 = Part0.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(Part1.CFrame)
                Weld.Parent = descendant_3.Parent
                descendant_3:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
end

local function buildPerformer(arg3) -- line: 324
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] ReplicatedStorage (copy)
    --  [2] MannequinRig_m (copy)
    --  [3] bodyColors (copy)
    --  [4] Locker_m (copy)
    --  [5] holdWorn (copy)

    local v31 = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Characters"):WaitForChild("Mannequin"):Clone()
    v31.Name = "FeaturedPerformer"
    local Pelvis = v31:FindFirstChild("Pelvis")
    local Rotation = v31:GetPivot().Rotation
    local v32 = math.huge

    for _, val_1 in { "Left", "Right" } do
        local v34 = v31:FindFirstChild(val_1 .. "Foot")

    local v35 = Pelvis.Position.Y - v32

    v32.Parent = v31
    local RootJointAttachment_Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
    RootJointAttachment_Attachment.Name = "RootJointAttachment"
    RootJointAttachment_Attachment.Parent = v32
    local Attachment_1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
    Attachment_1.Name = "RootJointAttachment"

    Attachment_1.Parent = Pelvis
    local Root_AnimationConstraint = Instance.new("AnimationConstraint")
    Root_AnimationConstraint.Name = "Root"
    Root_AnimationConstraint.Attachment0 = RootJointAttachment_Attachment
    Root_AnimationConstraint.Attachment1 = Attachment_1
    Root_AnimationConstraint.IsKinematic = true
    Root_AnimationConstraint.Parent = Pelvis

    for _, descendant_4 in v31:GetDescendants() do
        if descendant_4:IsA("BasePart") and descendant_4 ~= v32 then
            descendant_4.Anchored = false
            descendant_4.CanCollide, descendant_4.CanQuery, descendant_4.CanTouch = false, false, false

end

local function buildDisplay(
    arg4: any,
    vec1: Vector3,
    vec2: Vector3,
    n7: number,
    arg5: any,
    u12: userdata
) -- line: 382
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] buildPerformer (copy)
    --  [2] MannequinAnimation_m (copy)
    --  [3] Emotes_m (copy)
    --  [4] buildHead (copy)

    local cframe = CFrame.lookAt(vec1, vec1 + vec2)

    if arg4.kind == "Emote" then
        local v37, v36, v38 = buildPerformer(arg5)
        local vec3_1 = Vector3.new(vec1.X, n7 + v38, vec1.Z)
        v36.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(vec3_1, vec3_1 + vec2)
        v37.Parent = u12
        local v43 = MannequinAnimation_m.new(v37, { root = v36 })
        local Skeleton = MannequinAnimation_m.Skeleton
        local os_clock = os.clock()

        function v43.poseHook(arg6: any, arg7: any, arg8: any, _: number) -- line: 392
            -- upvalues:
            --  [1] Emotes_m (ref)
            --  [2] arg4 (copy)
            --  [3] os_clock (ref)
            --  [4] Skeleton (copy)

            local v44, Result_3 = pcall(Emotes_m.track, arg4.name)

            if v44 then
                if type(Result_3) ~= "table" then
                    return arg7
                end

                v44 = os.clock() - os_clock

                if v44 >= Result_3.duration + 0.8 then
                    os_clock = os.clock()
                    v44 = 0
                end

                local v45 = math.clamp(v44, 0, Result_3.duration)
                local v46 = Emotes_m.anchorOf(
                    Vector3.new(arg8.pos.X, arg8.groundY, arg8.pos.Z),
                    Emotes_m.yawOf(arg8.rootCF)
                )

                if Result_3.travel then
                    local v47 = Emotes_m.sample(Result_3, v45)
                    v46 *= CFrame.new(-v47.X, 0, -v47.Z)
                end

                local v48 = Emotes_m.pose(arg6.skeleton, Result_3, v45, v46)
                v46 = math.clamp(math.min(v44 / 0.35, 1 - (v44 - Result_3.duration) / 0.35), 0, 1)

                if v46 < 1 then
                    v48 = Skeleton.lerp(arg7, v48, v46 * v46 * (3 - v46 * 2), arg8.rootCF)
                end

                local v50 = arg6:_underGround(v48, arg8.groundY)

                if v50 > 0 then
                    v48.pelvis = v48.pelvis + Vector3.new(0, v50, 0)
                end

                return v48
            else
                return arg7
            end
        end

        local t_5 = { step = nil, destroy = nil }

        function t_5.step(n9: number, _: number) -- line: 422
            -- upvalues:
            --  [1] v36 (copy)
            --  [2] vec3_1 (copy)
            --  [3] vec2 (copy)
            --  [4] v43 (copy)

            v36.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(vec3_1, vec3_1 + vec2)
            v43:step(n9)
        end

        function t_5.destroy() -- line: 426
            -- upvalues:
            --  [1] v43 (copy)
            --  [2] v37 (copy)

            v43:destroy()
            v37:Destroy()
        end

        return t_5
    end

    local v52 = buildHead(arg4.kind, arg4.name)

    if not v52 then
        return nil
    end

    local v53 = if arg4.kind ~= "Expression" then false else true

    local function place(n11: number) -- line: 437
        -- upvalues:
        --  [1] v53 (copy)
        --  [2] v52 (copy)
        --  [3] cframe (copy)

        local v54 = math.sin(n11 * 2 * 3.141592653589793 / 3.4) * 0.4
        local v55 = if v53 then math.sin(n11 * 2 * 3.141592653589793 / 5) * 0.4886921905584123 else n11 * 0.6
        v52:PivotTo(cframe * CFrame.new(0, v54, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, v55, 0))
    end

    local v60 = if not v53 then 0 else 0
    v52:PivotTo(cframe * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, v60, 0))
    v52.Parent = u12
    v60 = { step = nil, destroy = nil }

    function v60.step(_: number, n13: number) -- line: 445
        -- upvalues:
        --  [1] place (copy)

        place(n13)
    end

    function v60.destroy() -- line: 448
        -- upvalues:
        --  [1] v52 (copy)

        v52:Destroy()
    end

    return v60
end

local function holdWorn(u2: userdata) -- line: 419

        end
    end
end

local function viewFrame() -- line: 798
    local Lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
    local v72 = Lobby and Lobby:FindFirstChild("Room") or workspace:FindFirstChild("Room")
    local v73 = Lobby

    if v73 then
        v73 = Lobby:FindFirstChild("lockerZone")
    end

    if v72 then
        if not v72:IsA("Model") then
            return nil
        end

        local v74 = v72:GetPivot()

        if v73 then
            if not v73:IsA("PVInstance") then
                return v74
            end

            v72 = (v73:GetPivot().Position - v74.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)

            if v72.Magnitude < 0.001 then
                return v74
            end

            v73 = v74.Position - v72.Unit * 4

            return CFrame.lookAt(v73, v73 - v72)
        else
            return v74
        end
    else
        return nil
    end
end

local function fade(t2: table, n2: number) -- line: 195
    local _ = function(n3: number) --[[ f ]] -- line: 196
        -- upvalues:
        --  [1] n2 (copy)

        return 1 - (1 - n3) * n2
    end

    for _, val in t2 do
        val.obj.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (1 - val.bg) * n2

        if val.text then
            val.obj.TextTransparency = 1 - (1 - val.text) * n2
        end

        if val.image then
            val.obj.ImageTransparency = 1 - (1 - val.image) * n2
        end

        for key_4, val_1 in val.stroke do
            key_4.Transparency = 1 - (1 - val_1) * n2
        end
    end
end

local function onScreen(u19: userdata, vec1: Vector3, n24: number) -- line: 980

    local v307 = -v306.Z

        return false
    end

    local v308 = math.tan(math.rad(u19.FieldOfView) / 2)
    local v310 = v308 * ViewportSize.X / math.max(ViewportSize.Y, 1)
    local v311 = math.max(v307, 0)

        v312 = math.abs(v306.Y) <= v308 * v311 + n24 * math.sqrt(v308 * v308 + 1) and true
    end

    return v312
end

local function preferredInput() -- line: 62
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] UserInputService (copy)

    if UserInputService.TouchEnabled and (not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled and not UserInputService.GamepadEnabled) then
        return "Touch"
    end

    local Success, Result = pcall(function() -- line: 66
        -- upvalues:
        --  [1] UserInputService (ref)

        return UserInputService.PreferredInput
    end)

    if Success and typeof(Result) == "EnumItem" then
        local Name = Result.Name

        if Name == "MicroGamepad" then
            return "Gamepad"
        end

        return Name
    end

    return if not UserInputService.TouchEnabled then "KeyboardAndMouse" else if UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled then "KeyboardAndMouse" else "Touch"
end

local function shows(u1: userdata?) -- line: 77

        end

    else
        return false
    end
end

local function keepBall(t14: table) -- line: 521
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] v26 (ref)
    --  [2] fade (copy)

    local Lost = t14.flags.lost

    if t14.me:has() then
        t14.flags.lost = nil

        return
    end

    if not Lost or Lost.reason == "pass" or t14.ball.mode == "path" then
        return
    end

    if not Lost.told then
        Lost.told = true

        if v26 then
            v26:FireServer("Retry", "DribbleLost")
        end
    end

    if os.clock() - Lost.t > 3.5 then
        fade(true, 0.2)
        t14.kick:cancel()
        t14.me:give()
        t14.flags.lost = nil
        fade(false, 0.2)
    end
end

local function stepDribble(t16: table) -- line: 640
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] Prompt_m (copy)
    --  [2] Spotlight_m (copy)
    --  [3] Hint_m (copy)
    --  [4] v26 (ref)
    --  [5] waitUntil (copy)

    t16.step = 1
    Prompt_m.show(1, 4, "Walk to the ball to begin dribbling", { "Move" })
    Spotlight_m.show(t16.ball.part)
    Hint_m.show(t16.ball.part, { "Move" })

    if not t16.sent.DribblePrompt then
        t16.sent.DribblePrompt = true

        if v26 then
            v26:FireServer("DribblePrompt", nil)
        end
    end

    t16.me.canTake = true
    local v111 = true
    waitUntil(function() -- line: 648
        -- upvalues:
        --  [1] t16 (copy)
        --  [2] v26 (ref)
        --  [3] v111 (ref)
        --  [4] Hint_m (ref)

        if not t16.sent.DribbleMoved then
            local MovingDirection = t16.cm.MovingDirection

            if Vector3.new(MovingDirection.X, 0, MovingDirection.Z).Magnitude > 0.1 then
                local v112 = t16

                if not v112.sent.DribbleMoved then
                    v112.sent.DribbleMoved = true

                    if v26 then
                        v26:FireServer("DribbleMoved", nil)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local v113 = t16.root.Position - t16.ball.pos
        local Magnitude_2: Vector3 = Vector3.new(v113.X, 0, v113.Z).Magnitude

        if v111 and Magnitude_2 < 7 then
            Hint_m.hide()
            v111 = false
        elseif not v111 and Magnitude_2 > 11 then
            Hint_m.show(t16.ball.part, { "Move" })
            v111 = true
        end

        return t16.me:has()
    end)
    Hint_m.hide()

    if not t16.sent.DribbleMoved then
        t16.sent.DribbleMoved = true

        if v26 then
            v26:FireServer("DribbleMoved", nil)
        end
    end

    if not t16.sent.DribbleDone then
        t16.sent.DribbleDone = true

        if v26 then
            v26:FireServer("DribbleDone", nil)
        end
    end

    t16.flags.lost = nil
    Spotlight_m.hide()
    Prompt_m.done()
end

local function stepPass(t17: table) -- line: 672
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] Prompt_m (copy)
    --  [2] t (copy)
    --  [3] v26 (ref)
    --  [4] Keys_m (copy)
    --  [5] Spotlight_m (copy)
    --  [6] Hint_m (copy)
    --  [7] waitUntil (copy)
    --  [8] keepBall (copy)
    --  [9] t_1 (copy)
    --  [10] fade (copy)

    t17.step = 2
    local Me = t17.me
    local Mate_2 = t17.mate
    local Kick_1 = t17.kick
    local Ball_1 = t17.ball

    function Kick_1.assistTo() -- line: 675
        -- upvalues:
        --  [1] Mate_2 (copy)
        --  [2] Me (copy)
        --  [3] t17 (copy)

        local Position_3 = Mate_2.root.Position
        local v114 = Me.root.Position - Position_3
        local vec3_4 = Vector3.new(v114.X, 0, v114.Z)

        return Vector3.new(Position_3.X, t17.world.groundY, Position_3.Z) + (if vec3_4.Magnitude > 0.001 then vec3_4.Unit * 1.2 else Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
    end

    t17.controls:set({ Pass = true, Tools = true })
    Prompt_m.show(2, 4, "Hold, then let go to pass to your teammate", t)

    if not t17.sent.PassPrompt then
        t17.sent.PassPrompt = true

        if v26 then
            v26:FireServer("PassPrompt", nil)
        end
    end

    if Keys_m.device() == "Keyboard" and t17.controls.tool == "Shoot" and not t17.sent.PassTool then
        t17.sent.PassTool = true

        if v26 then
            v26:FireServer("PassTool", nil)
        end
    end

    local t_8 = { at = nil, pitch = false, untilT = nil, ease = 7 }

    function t_8.at() -- line: 688
        -- upvalues:
        --  [1] Mate_2 (copy)

        return Mate_2.root.Position
    end

    t_8.untilT = os.clock() + 1.5
    t17.aim = t_8
    Spotlight_m.show(Mate_2.model)
    local Head = Mate_2.model:FindFirstChild("Head")

    local function overMate() -- line: 695
        -- upvalues:
        --  [1] Head (copy)
        --  [2] Mate_2 (copy)

        return (if Head then if Head:IsA("BasePart") then Head.Position else Mate_2.root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) else Mate_2.root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)) + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
    end

    local v116 = os.clock()

    while true do
        t17.flags.passAt = nil
        t17.flags.mateTook = nil
        Me.canTake = true
        Mate_2.canTake = false
        Hint_m.show(overMate, t)
        waitUntil(function() -- line: 707
            -- upvalues:
            --  [1] v116 (ref)
            --  [2] Kick_1 (copy)
            --  [3] Spotlight_m (ref)
            --  [4] t17 (copy)
            --  [5] keepBall (ref)

            if v116 and (os.clock() - v116 > 2.5 or Kick_1.charging) then
                Spotlight_m.hide()
                v116 = nil
            end

            if t17.flags.passAt then
                return true
            end

            keepBall(t17)

            return false
        end)
        Hint_m.hide()

        if v116 then
            Spotlight_m.hide()
            v116 = nil
        end

        Me.canTake = false
        Mate_2.canTake = true
        local PassAt = t17.flags.passAt
        local PassFrom = t17.flags.passFrom
        waitUntil(function() -- line: 728
            -- upvalues:
            --  [1] Mate_2 (copy)
            --  [2] PassAt (copy)
            --  [3] Ball_1 (copy)
            --  [4] PassFrom (copy)

            if Mate_2:has() then
                return true
            end

            local clock_5 = os.clock()
            local Pos_1, Position_4, Position_5

            if not (clock_5 - PassAt > 5) then
                if Ball_1.mode == "free" and clock_5 - PassAt > 0.5 and Ball_1:resting() then
                    return true
                end

                Position_4 = Mate_2.root.Position
                local v119 = Vector3.new(Position_4.X, 0, Position_4.Z) - PassFrom
                local v120 = false

                if v119.Magnitude > 1 then
                    Pos_1 = Ball_1.pos
                    Position_5 = Mate_2.root.Position
                    v120 = (Vector3.new(Pos_1.X, 0, Pos_1.Z) - Vector3.new(
                        Position_5.X,
                        0,
                        Position_5.Z
                    )):Dot(v119.Unit) > 20 and true
                end

                return v120
            end

            return true
        end)

        if Mate_2:has() then
            break
        end

        if v26 then
            v26:FireServer("Retry", "PassMissed")
        end

        Prompt_m.nudge(t_1.PassMissed)
        Mate_2.canTake = false
        fade(true, 0.2)
        t17.kick:cancel()
        t17.me:give()
        t17.flags.lost = nil
        fade(false, 0.2)
    end

    if not t17.sent.PassDone then
        t17.sent.PassDone = true

        if v26 then
            v26:FireServer("PassDone", nil)
        end
    end

    Kick_1.assistTo = nil
    t17.controls:set({})
    Prompt_m.done()
end

local function backSpot(t23: table) -- line: 1059
    local Lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
    local v162 = Lobby

    if v162 then
        v162 = Lobby:FindFirstChild("Floor")
    end

    local v163 = Lobby

    if v163 then
        v163 = Lobby:FindFirstChild("queueZone")
    end

    local PelvisHeight = t23.model:GetAttribute("PelvisHeight")
    local raycastParams, vec3_9

    if t23.model:GetAttribute("Team") == nil then
        if v162 then
            if v162:IsA("Model") then
                if type(PelvisHeight) ~= "number" then
                    return t23.home
                end

                local v164, v165 = v162:GetBoundingBox()
                local v166 = v164.Position + Vector3.new(0, v165.Y / 2, 0)
                raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
                raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { v162 }
                v162 = workspace:Raycast(
                    v166 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0),
                    Vector3.new(0, -6 - v165.Y, 0),
                    raycastParams
                )
                vec3_9 = Vector3.new(
                    v166.X,
                    (if v162 then v162.Position.Y else v166.Y) + PelvisHeight,
                    v166.Z
                )
                v166 = if v163 then if v163:IsA("Model") then v163:GetBoundingBox().Position - vec3_9 else t23.home.LookVector else t23.home.LookVector
                v166 = Vector3.new(v166.X, 0, v166.Z)

                if v166.Magnitude < 0.001 then
                    v166 = Vector3.new(t23.home.LookVector.X, 0, t23.home.LookVector.Z)
                end

                if v166.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                    return (CFrame.lookAt(vec3_9, vec3_9 + v166.Unit))
                end

                return (CFrame.new(vec3_9))
            else
                return t23.home
            end
        else
            return t23.home
        end
    else
        return t23.home
    end
end

        local function fitMembers() -- line: 2031
            -- upvalues:
            --  [1] v191 (copy)
            --  [2] v188 (copy)
            --  [3] v238 (ref)

            local v754 = v191

            if v754 then
                v754 = v191:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
            end

            local v755 = v191

            if v755 then
                v755 = v191:FindFirstChild("Card")
            end

            local v756 = if not v188 then Vector2.zero else v188.AbsoluteSize

            if v188 then
                if v754 then
                    if v755 then
                        if not v755:IsA("GuiObject") or v756.X <= 0 or v756.Y <= 0 then
                            return
                        end

                        local v758 = math.max(1, (math.ceil(v238.max / 5)))
                        local v759 = v756.X / 5 * 0.995
                        local v760 = math.min(v756.Y / v758 * 0.995, v759 / v754.AspectRatio)
                        local v761 = v754.AspectRatio * v755.Size.X.Scale / v755.Size.Y.Scale

                        for _, child_7 in v188:GetChildren() do
                            v755 = child_7:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
                            v754 = child_7:FindFirstChild("Card")

                            if child_7:IsA("GuiObject") and child_7:GetAttribute("ClubRow") and v755 and v754 then
                                child_7.Size = UDim2.new(
                                    v759 / v756.X,
                                    0,
                                    child_7.Size.Y.Scale,
                                    child_7.Size.Y.Offset
                                )
                                v755.AspectRatio = v759 / v760
                                v755 = v754:FindFirstChild("Shape") or Instance.new(
                                    "UIAspectRatioConstraint"
                                )

                                if v755:IsA("UIAspectRatioConstraint") then
                                    v755.Name = "Shape"
                                    v755.AspectRatio = v761
                                    v755.Parent = v754
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        return
                    end

                    return
                else
                    return
                end
            else
                return
            end
        end

            if v188:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
                v188.ScrollBarThickness = 0
                v188.VerticalScrollBarInset = Enum.ScrollBarInset.None
                v188:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fitMembers)
            end
        end

local function fit(t4: table, u17: userdata) -- line: 627
    local Adornee: userdata = t4.gui.Adornee
    local Position

    if Adornee then
        if not Adornee:IsA("BasePart") then
            return
        end

        Position = Adornee.Position
        local v99 = 2 * (Position - u17.CFrame.Position).Magnitude * math.tan(
            math.rad(u17.FieldOfView) / 2
        )
        local v100 = math.clamp(t4.size.Y, 0.47 * v99, 0.67 * v99)

        if math.abs(v100 - t4.height) <= v100 * 0.005 then
            return
        end

        t4.height = v100
        t4.gui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(v100 * t4.size.X / t4.size.Y, v100)

        if t4.floorY then
            t4.gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(
                0,
                math.max(0, t4.floorY + 1 + v100 / 2 - Position.Y),
                0
            )
        end

        return
    else
        return
    end
end

local function onPlayZone(u18: userdata, vec1: Vector3) -- line: 646
    local QueueZone = u18:FindFirstChild("queueZone")

    if QueueZone then
        if not QueueZone:IsA("Model") then
            return false
        end

        local v103, v104 = QueueZone:GetBoundingBox()
        local v105 = v103:PointToObjectSpace(vec1)
        local v106 = false

        if math.abs(v105.X) <= v104.X / 2 then
            local v108 = math.abs(v105.Z)
            v106 = v108 <= v104.Z / 2 and true
        end

        return v106
    else
        return false
    end
end

local function preferredInput() -- line: 473

    --  [1] UserInputService (copy)

local function settledPing() -- line: 193

    --  [1] t (copy)
    --  [2] pingNow (copy)

            break

local function buildHead(s8: string, s9: string) -- line: 264
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] ReplicatedStorage (copy)
    --  [2] Locker_m (copy)
    --  [3] bodyColors (copy)

    local Mannequin = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Characters"):WaitForChild("Mannequin")
    local Head = Mannequin:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local v24 = if s8 ~= "Expression" then false else true
    local Skin

    if Head then
        if Head:IsA("BasePart") then
            if not (if v24 then Locker_m.face(s9) else Locker_m.item(s8, s9)) then
                return nil
            end

            v24 = Instance.new("Model")
            v24.Name = "FeaturedHead"
            local v26 = Head:Clone()

            for _, child in v26:GetChildren() do
                if not child:IsA("Constraint") then
                    if child:IsA("JointInstance") then
                        child:Destroy()
                    end
                else
                    child:Destroy()
                end
            end

            v26.CFrame = (Mannequin:GetPivot():Inverse() * Head.CFrame).Rotation
            v26.Anchored = true
            v26.Parent = v24
            Locker_m.dress(v24, { [s8] = s9 })
            Skin = bodyColors().Skin

            if Skin then
                v26.Color = Skin
            end

            for _, descendant in v24:GetDescendants() do
                if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                    descendant.Anchored = true
                    descendant.CanCollide, descendant.CanQuery, descendant.CanTouch = false, false, false
                elseif descendant:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
                    descendant:Destroy()
                end
            end

            local v28, v29 = v24:GetBoundingBox()
            v24.WorldPivot = CFrame.new(v28.Position)
            v24:ScaleTo(4.2 / math.max(v29.X, v29.Y, v29.Z, 0.1))

            return v24
        else
            return nil
        end
    else
        return nil
    end
end

local function holdWorn(u11: userdata) -- line: 306
    for _, descendant_3 in u11:GetDescendants() do
        if descendant_3:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
            local Part0 = descendant_3.Part0
            local Part1 = descendant_3.Part1

            if Part0 and Part1 then
                local Weld = Instance.new("Weld")
                Weld.Name = descendant_3.Name
                Weld.Part0 = Part0
                Weld.Part1 = Part1
                Weld.C0 = Part0.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(Part1.CFrame)
                Weld.Parent = descendant_3.Parent
                descendant_3:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
end

local function buildPerformer(arg3) -- line: 324
    -- upvalues:

local function fit(arg12: any, u26: userdata) -- line: 951
    local Adornee = arg12.gui.Adornee
    local Position

    if Adornee then
        if not Adornee:IsA("BasePart") then
            return
        end

        Position = Adornee.Position
        local v166 = 2 * (Position - u26.CFrame.Position).Magnitude * math.tan(
            math.rad(u26.FieldOfView) / 2
        )
        local v167 = math.clamp(arg12.size.Y, arg12.least * v166, arg12.most * v166)

        if math.abs(v167 - arg12.height) <= v167 * 0.005 then
            return
        end

        arg12.height = v167
        arg12.gui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(v167 * arg12.size.X / arg12.size.Y, v167)

        if arg12.floorY then
            arg12.gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(
                0,
                math.max(0, arg12.floorY + 1 + v167 / 2 - Position.Y),
                0
            )
        end

        return
    else
        return
    end
end

local function itemName(arg6) -- line: 290
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] Emotes_m (copy)
    --  [2] Locker_m (copy)

    if arg6.kind == "Emote" then
        local Success_1, Result_1 = pcall(Emotes_m.label, arg6.name)

        if Success_1 and type(Result_1) == "string" and Result_1 ~= "" then
            return string.upper(Result_1)
        end
    elseif arg6.kind == "Expression" then
        local v28 = Locker_m.face(arg6.name)
        local v29 = v28

        if v29 then
            v29 = v28:GetAttribute("DisplayName")
        end

        if type(v29) == "string" then
            return string.upper(v29)
        end
    elseif arg6.kind == "Coins" then
        local v30 = arg6.coins or arg6.name
        local str = tostring((math.floor(tonumber(v30) or 0)))

        return "+" .. string.gsub(
            string.reverse((string.gsub(string.reverse(str), "(%d%d%d)", "%1,"))),
            "^,",
            ""
        )
    end

    local str_1 = tostring(arg6.name)

    return (string.upper((string.gsub(str_1, "(%l)(%u)", "%1 %2"))))
end

local function viewFrame() -- line: 798
    local Lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
    local v72 = Lobby and Lobby:FindFirstChild("Room") or workspace:FindFirstChild("Room")
    local v73 = Lobby

    if v73 then
        v73 = Lobby:FindFirstChild("lockerZone")
    end

    if v72 then
        if not v72:IsA("Model") then
            return nil
        end

        local v74 = v72:GetPivot()

        if v73 then
            if not v73:IsA("PVInstance") then
                return v74
            end

            v72 = (v73:GetPivot().Position - v74.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)

            if v72.Magnitude < 0.001 then
                return v74
            end

            v73 = v74.Position - v72.Unit * 4

            return CFrame.lookAt(v73, v73 - v72)
        else
            return v74
        end
    else
        return nil
    end
end

local function packModel(s8: string, arg10: any) -- line: 817
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] ReplicatedStorage (copy)
    --  [2] t_7 (copy)

    local v75 = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PackAssets")
    local v76 = v75

    if v76 then
        v76 = v75:FindFirstChild("Pack")
    end

    local Skins

    if v76 then
        if not v76:IsA("Model") then
            return nil
        end

        local v77 = t_7[s8] or t_7.Accessory
        local v78 = if type(arg10) == "table" then arg10.design or (arg10[1] or v77.design) else v77.design
        local v79 = if type(arg10) == "table" then arg10.rarity or (arg10[2] or v77.rarity) else v77.rarity
        Skins = v75:FindFirstChild("Skins")
        v75 = Skins

        if v75 then
            v75 = Skins:FindFirstChild(v78)

            if v75 then
                v75 = Skins[v78]:FindFirstChild(v79)
            end
        end

        if not v75 then
            local v80 = Skins

            if v80 then
                v80 = Skins:FindFirstChild(v77.design)

                if v80 then
                    v80 = Skins[v77.design]:FindFirstChild(v77.rarity)
                end
            end

            v75 = v80
        end

        local v81 = v76:Clone()
        v81.Name = "OpeningPack"

        if v75 then
            for _, val_2 in { "Body", "Top" } do
                v79 = v81:FindFirstChild(val_2)

                if v79 then
                    v78 = v79:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")

                    if v78 then
                        v78:Destroy()
                    end

                    v75:Clone().Parent = v79
                end
            end
        end

        for _, descendant_5 in v81:GetDescendants() do
            if descendant_5:IsA("BasePart") then
                descendant_5.Anchored = true
                descendant_5.CanCollide, descendant_5.CanQuery, descendant_5.CanTouch = false, false, false
            end
        end

        v81:ScaleTo(1.2)
        v77 = {}

        for _, val_3 in { "A", "B", "Base", "Ink" } do
            v76 = v75

            if v76 then
                v76 = v75:GetAttribute(val_3)
            end

            v77[val_3] = if typeof(v76) == "Color3" then v76 else Color3.fromRGB(170, 70, 255)
        end

        v81:SetAttribute("GlowA", v77.A)
        v81:SetAttribute("GlowB", v77.B)
        v81:SetAttribute("GlowBase", v77.Base)

        return v81
    else
        return nil
    end
end

end

local function device() -- line: 327

        -- upvalues:
        --  [1] UserInputService (ref)

        return UserInputService.PreferredInput
    end)

    if Success and typeof(Result) == "EnumItem" then
        local Name = Result.Name

        return if Name == "Gamepad" then "Gamepad" else if Name ~= "MicroGamepad" then if Name ~= "Touch" then "Keyboard" else "Touch" else "Gamepad"
    end

    local v49 = UserInputService:GetLastInputType()

    if v49.Name:sub(1, 7) == "Gamepad" then
        return "Gamepad"
    end

    if v49 == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

end

local function mateBrain(t8: table, arg1: any) -- line: 390
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] Tuning (copy)
    --  [2] inside (copy)
    --  [3] Bots_m (copy)

    local Position = arg1.root.Position
    local vec3_1 = Vector3.new(Position.X, 0, Position.Z)
    local Position_1 = t8.me.root.Position
    local v60 = Vector3.new(Position_1.X, 0, Position_1.Z) - vec3_1
    local Magnitude = v60.Magnitude
    local Ball = t8.ball
    local v61 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    local v62 = Tuning.Speed.Jog
    local v63 = if Magnitude > 0.5 then v60.Unit else nil

    if arg1:has() then
        v63 = nil
    elseif t8.step == 2 and (t8.flags.passAt and Ball.mode == "free") then
        local Pos = Ball.pos
        local vec3_2 = Vector3.new(Pos.X, 0, Pos.Z)
        local Vel = Ball.vel
        local vec3_3 = Vector3.new(Vel.X, 0, Vel.Z)
        local Magnitude_1 = vec3_3.Magnitude

        if Magnitude_1 > 3 then
            local v64 = vec3_3 / Magnitude_1
            local v65 = (vec3_1 - vec3_2):Dot(v64)

            if v65 > 0 then
                local v66 = vec3_2 + v64 * v65 - vec3_1

                if v66.Magnitude > 1.5 and v66.Magnitude < 14 then
                    v61 = v66.Unit
                    v62 = Tuning.Speed.Sprint
                end
            end

            v63 = -v64
        else
            local v67 = vec3_2 - vec3_1

            if v67.Magnitude > 1.5 and v67.Magnitude < 25 then
                v61 = v67.Unit
                v63 = v67.Unit
            end
        end
    elseif t8.step == 2 and not t8.kick:busy() and not t8.flags.passAt and Magnitude > 0.5 then
        if Magnitude > 36 then
            v61 = v60.Unit * math.clamp((Magnitude - 36) / 6, 0.3, 1)
        elseif Magnitude < 16 then
            v61 = -v60.Unit * math.clamp((16 - Magnitude) / 6, 0.3, 1)
        end
    end

    v61 = if not (v61.Magnitude > 0) then v61 else if inside(t8, vec3_1 + v61.Unit * 3) then v61 else Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    Bots_m.drive(arg1.model, v61, v62, v63)
end

local function keepBall(t14: table) -- line: 521
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] v26 (ref)
    --  [2] fade (copy)

    local Lost = t14.flags.lost

    if t14.me:has() then
        t14.flags.lost = nil

        return
    end

    if not Lost or Lost.reason == "pass" or t14.ball.mode == "path" then
        return
    end

    if not Lost.told then
        Lost.told = true

        if v26 then
            v26:FireServer("Retry", "DribbleLost")
        end
    end

    if os.clock() - Lost.t > 3.5 then
        fade(true, 0.2)
        t14.kick:cancel()
        t14.me:give()
        t14.flags.lost = nil
        fade(false, 0.2)
    end
end

local function stepDribble(t16: table) -- line: 640
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] Prompt_m (copy)
    --  [2] Spotlight_m (copy)
    --  [3] Hint_m (copy)
    --  [4] v26 (ref)
    --  [5] waitUntil (copy)

    t16.step = 1
    Prompt_m.show(1, 4, "Walk to the ball to begin dribbling", { "Move" })
    Spotlight_m.show(t16.ball.part)
    Hint_m.show(t16.ball.part, { "Move" })

    if not t16.sent.DribblePrompt then
        t16.sent.DribblePrompt = true

        if v26 then
            v26:FireServer("DribblePrompt", nil)
        end
    end

    t16.me.canTake = true
    local v111 = true
    waitUntil(function() -- line: 648
        -- upvalues:
        --  [1] t16 (copy)
        --  [2] v26 (ref)
        --  [3] v111 (ref)
        --  [4] Hint_m (ref)

        if not t16.sent.DribbleMoved then
            local MovingDirection = t16.cm.MovingDirection

            if Vector3.new(MovingDirection.X, 0, MovingDirection.Z).Magnitude > 0.1 then
                local v112 = t16

                if not v112.sent.DribbleMoved then
                    v112.sent.DribbleMoved = true

                    if v26 then
                        v26:FireServer("DribbleMoved", nil)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local v113 = t16.root.Position - t16.ball.pos
        local Magnitude_2: Vector3 = Vector3.new(v113.X, 0, v113.Z).Magnitude

        if v111 and Magnitude_2 < 7 then
            Hint_m.hide()
            v111 = false
        elseif not v111 and Magnitude_2 > 11 then
            Hint_m.show(t16.ball.part, { "Move" })
            v111 = true
        end

        return t16.me:has()
    end)
    Hint_m.hide()

    if not t16.sent.DribbleMoved then
        t16.sent.DribbleMoved = true

        if v26 then
            v26:FireServer("DribbleMoved", nil)
        end
    end

    if not t16.sent.DribbleDone then
        t16.sent.DribbleDone = true

        if v26 then
            v26:FireServer("DribbleDone", nil)
        end
    end

    t16.flags.lost = nil
    Spotlight_m.hide()
    Prompt_m.done()
end

local function moodMove(arg27: any, arg28: any, n22: number) -- line: 1088
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] drive (copy)
    --  [2] Tuning (copy)
    --  [3] Bodies_m (copy)
    --  [4] steer (copy)
    --  [5] inside (copy)

    local Position_16 = arg27.root.Position
    local vec3_40 = Vector3.new(Position_16.X, 0, Position_16.Z)
    local Plan = arg28.plan

    if Plan == "Celebrate" then
        if n22 < arg28.untilT then
            drive(arg27, arg28.dir, Tuning.Speed.Sprint * arg27.S.Sprint, arg28.dir)

            return
        end

        if not arg28.slid then
            arg28.slid = true
            Bodies_m.slide(arg27.model, arg28.dir, if arg27.rng:NextNumber() < 0.5 then 1 else 2)

            return
        end

        drive(arg27, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Tuning.Speed.Jog, nil)

        return
    else
        if Plan == "Join" then
            local v301 = arg28.target

            if v301 then
                v301 = arg28.target.Parent

                if v301 then
                    v301 = arg28.target:FindFirstChild("Root")
                end
            end

            if v301 and v301:IsA("BasePart") then
                local Position_17 = v301.Position
                local v302 = Vector3.new(Position_17.X, 0, Position_17.Z) + arg28.offset
                local Position_18 = v301.Position
                local v303 = Vector3.new(Position_18.X, 0, Position_18.Z) - vec3_40

                if (v302 - vec3_40).Magnitude > 1.5 then
                    steer(
                        arg27,
                        v302,
                        true,
                        nil,
                        n22
                    )

                    return
                else
                    drive(arg27, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Tuning.Speed.Jog, v303)

                    return
                end
            end

            drive(arg27, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Tuning.Speed.Jog, nil)

            return
        end

        if Plan == "Wander" then
            if n22 > arg28.next or (arg28.to - vec3_40).Magnitude < 2 then
                local v304 = inside
                local v305 = arg27.rng:NextNumber() * 3.141592653589793 * 2
                local v306 = math.cos(v305)
                local v307 = math.sin(v305)
                arg28.to = v304(
                    vec3_40 + Vector3.new(v306 * 1 - v307 * 0, 0, v307 * 1 + v306 * 0) * (8 + arg27.rng:NextNumber() * 18)
                )
                arg28.next = n22 + 2 + arg27.rng:NextNumber() * 2
            end

            steer(
                arg27,
                arg28.to,
                false,
                nil,
                n22,
                Tuning.Speed.Jog
            )

            return
        end

        if Plan == "Walk" then
            if (arg28.to - vec3_40).Magnitude > 2 then
                steer(
                    arg27,
                    arg28.to,
                    false,
                    nil,
                    n22,
                    Tuning.Speed.Jog * 0.45
                )

                return
            end

            drive(arg27, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Tuning.Speed.Jog, nil)

            return
        else
            drive(arg27, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Tuning.Speed.Jog, arg28.face)

            return
        end
    end
end

local function moodMove(arg27: any, arg28: any, n22: number) -- line: 1088
    -- upvalues:
    --  [1] drive (copy)
    --  [2] Tuning (copy)
    --  [3] Bodies_m (copy)
    --  [4] steer (copy)
    --  [5] inside (copy)

    local Position_16 = arg27.root.Position
    local vec3_40 = Vector3.new(Position_16.X, 0, Position_16.Z)
    local Plan = arg28.plan

    if Plan == "Celebrate" then

            return
        end

        if not arg28.slid then
            arg28.slid = true
            Bodies_m.slide(arg27.model, arg28.dir, if arg27.rng:NextNumber() < 0.5 then 1 else 2)

                        arg27,
                        v302,
                        true,
                        nil,
                        n22
                    )

                    return
                else

                    return
                end
            end

            drive(arg27, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Tuning.Speed.Jog, nil)

            return
        end

        if Plan == "Wander" then
            if n22 > arg28.next or (arg28.to - vec3_40).Magnitude < 2 then
                local v304 = inside
                local v305 = arg27.rng:NextNumber() * 3.141592653589793 * 2

                arg28.to = v304(

        end
    end
end

function t.keyOf(u1: userdata, s5: string) -- line: 412
